blocks.text: There are no entrance exams. Admission is based on a competition based on the average grade of the educational document (certificate or diploma).
— 1 year 10 months – based on secondary general education;
— 2 years 10 months — based on basic general education.
The college provides education on a contract basis.
After graduating from college graduates have the opportunity to further obtain higher education in a shortened form (by time frame) curriculum.
Works at the college scientific and pedagogical staff highly qualified, with more than 3 years of teaching experience and whose specialties correspond to the disciplines taught.
